blocks.source: Canto XXXII
blocks.translation: Canto XXXII

blocks.source: S’ïo avessi le rime aspre e chiocce,
blocks.translation: If I had rhymes both rough and stridulous,

blocks.source: come si converrebbe al tristo buco
blocks.translation: As were appropriate to the dismal hole

blocks.source: sovra ’l qual pontan tutte l’altre rocce,
blocks.translation: Down upon which thrust all the other rocks,

blocks.source: io premerei di mio concetto il suco
blocks.translation: I would press out the juice of my conception

blocks.source: più pienamente; ma perch’ io non l’abbo,
blocks.translation: More fully; but because I have them not,

blocks.source: non sanza tema a dicer mi conduco;
blocks.translation: Not without fear I bring myself to speak;

blocks.source: ché non è impresa da pigliare a gabbo
blocks.translation: For ’tis no enterprise to take in jest,

blocks.source: discriver fondo a tutto l’universo,
blocks.translation: To sketch the bottom of all the universe,

blocks.source: né da lingua che chiami mamma o babbo.
blocks.translation: Nor for a tongue that cries Mamma and Babbo.

blocks.source: Ma quelle donne aiutino il mio verso
blocks.translation: But may those Ladies help this verse of mine,

blocks.source: ch’aiutaro Anfïone a chiuder Tebe,
blocks.translation: Who helped Amphion in enclosing Thebes,

blocks.source: sì che dal fatto il dir non sia diverso.
blocks.translation: That from the fact the word be not diverse.

blocks.source: Oh sovra tutte mal creata plebe
blocks.translation: O rabble ill-begotten above all,

blocks.source: che stai nel loco onde parlare è duro,
blocks.translation: Who’re in the place to speak of which is hard,

blocks.source: mei foste state qui pecore o zebe!
blocks.translation: ’Twere better ye had here been sheep or goats!

blocks.source: Come noi fummo giù nel pozzo scuro
blocks.translation: When we were down within the darksome well,

blocks.source: sotto i piè del gigante assai più bassi,
blocks.translation: Beneath the giant’s feet, but lower far,

blocks.source: e io mirava ancora a l’alto muro,
blocks.translation: And I was scanning still the lofty wall,

blocks.source: dicere udi’mi: «Guarda come passi:
blocks.translation: I heard it said to me: “Look how thou steppest!

blocks.source: va sì, che tu non calchi con le piante
blocks.translation: Take heed thou do not trample with thy feet

blocks.source: le teste de’ fratei miseri lassi».
blocks.translation: The heads of the tired, miserable brothers!”

blocks.source: Per ch’io mi volsi, e vidimi davante
blocks.translation: Whereat I turned me round, and saw before me

blocks.source: e sotto i piedi un lago che per gelo
blocks.translation: And underfoot a lake, that from the frost

blocks.source: avea di vetro e non d’acqua sembiante.
blocks.translation: The semblance had of glass, and not of water.

blocks.source: Non fece al corso suo sì grosso velo
blocks.translation: So thick a veil ne’er made upon its current

blocks.source: di verno la Danoia in Osterlicchi,
blocks.translation: In winter-time Danube in Austria,

blocks.source: né Tanaï là sotto ’l freddo cielo,
blocks.translation: Nor there beneath the frigid sky the Don,

blocks.source: com’ era quivi; che se Tambernicchi
blocks.translation: As there was here; so that if Tambernich

blocks.source: vi fosse sù caduto, o Pietrapana,
blocks.translation: Had fallen upon it, or Pietrapana,

blocks.source: non avria pur da l’orlo fatto cricchi.
blocks.translation: E’en at the edge ’twould not have given a creak.

blocks.source: E come a gracidar si sta la rana
blocks.translation: And as to croak the frog doth place himself

blocks.source: col muso fuor de l’acqua, quando sogna
blocks.translation: With muzzle out of water,—when is dreaming

blocks.source: di spigolar sovente la villana,
blocks.translation: Of gleaning oftentimes the peasant-girl,—

blocks.source: livide, insin là dove appar vergogna
blocks.translation: Livid, up to their faces, where shame appears,

blocks.source: eran l’ombre dolenti ne la ghiaccia,
blocks.translation: Were the disconsolate shades within the ice,

blocks.source: mettendo i denti in nota di cicogna.
blocks.translation: Setting their teeth unto the note of storks.

blocks.source: Ognuna in giù tenea volta la faccia;
blocks.translation: Each one his countenance held downward bent;

blocks.source: da bocca il freddo, e da li occhi il cor tristo
blocks.translation: From mouth the cold, from eyes the doleful heart

blocks.source: tra lor testimonianza si procaccia.
blocks.translation: Among them witness of itself procures.

blocks.source: Quand’ io m’ebbi dintorno alquanto visto,
blocks.translation: When round about me somewhat I had looked,

blocks.source: volsimi a’ piedi, e vidi due sì stretti,
blocks.translation: I downward turned me, and saw two so close,

blocks.source: che ’l pel del capo avieno insieme misto.
blocks.translation: The hair upon their heads together mingled.

blocks.source: «Ditemi, voi che sì strignete i petti»,
blocks.translation: “Ye who so strain your breasts together, tell me,”

blocks.source: diss’ io, «chi siete?». E quei piegaro i colli;
blocks.translation: I said, “who are you;” and they bent their necks,

blocks.source: e poi ch’ebber li visi a me eretti,
blocks.translation: And when to me their faces they had lifted,

blocks.source: li occhi lor, ch’eran pria pur dentro molli,
blocks.translation: Their eyes, which first were only moist within,

blocks.source: gocciar su per le labbra, e ’l gelo strinse
blocks.translation: Gushed o’er the eyelids, and the frost congealed

blocks.source: le lagrime tra essi e riserrolli.
blocks.translation: The tears between, and locked them up again.

blocks.source: Con legno legno spranga mai non cinse
blocks.translation: Clamp never bound together wood with wood

blocks.source: forte così; ond’ ei come due becchi
blocks.translation: So strongly; whereat they, like two he-goats,

blocks.source: cozzaro insieme, tanta ira li vinse.
blocks.translation: Butted together, so much wrath o’ercame them.

blocks.source: E un ch’avea perduti ambo li orecchi
blocks.translation: And one, who had by reason of the cold

blocks.source: per la freddura, pur col viso in giùe,
blocks.translation: Lost both his ears, still with his visage downward,

blocks.source: disse: «Perché cotanto in noi ti specchi?
blocks.translation: Said: “Why dost thou so mirror thyself in us?

blocks.source: Se vuoi saper chi son cotesti due,
blocks.translation: If thou desire to know who these two are,

blocks.source: la valle onde Bisenzo si dichina
blocks.translation: The valley whence Bisenzio descends

blocks.source: del padre loro Alberto e di lor fue.
blocks.translation: Belonged to them and to their father Albert.

blocks.source: D’un corpo usciro; e tutta la Caina
blocks.translation: They from one body came, and all Caina

blocks.source: potrai cercare, e non troverai ombra
blocks.translation: Thou shalt search through, and shalt not find a shade

blocks.source: degna più d’esser fitta in gelatina:
blocks.translation: More worthy to be fixed in gelatine;

blocks.source: non quelli a cui fu rotto il petto e l’ombra
blocks.translation: Not he in whom were broken breast and shadow

blocks.source: con esso un colpo per la man d’Artù;
blocks.translation: At one and the same blow by Arthur’s hand;

blocks.source: non Focaccia; non questi che m’ingombra
blocks.translation: Focaccia not; not he who me encumbers

blocks.source: col capo sì, ch’i’ non veggio oltre più,
blocks.translation: So with his head I see no farther forward,

blocks.source: e fu nomato Sassol Mascheroni;
blocks.translation: And bore the name of Sassol Mascheroni;

blocks.source: se tosco se’, ben sai omai chi fu.
blocks.translation: Well knowest thou who he was, if thou art Tuscan.

blocks.source: E perché non mi metti in più sermoni,
blocks.translation: And that thou put me not to further speech,

blocks.source: sappi ch’i’ fu’ il Camiscion de’ Pazzi;
blocks.translation: Know that I Camicion de’ Pazzi was,

blocks.source: e aspetto Carlin che mi scagioni».
blocks.translation: And wait Carlino to exonerate me.”

blocks.source: Poscia vid’ io mille visi cagnazzi
blocks.translation: Then I beheld a thousand faces, made

blocks.source: fatti per freddo; onde mi vien riprezzo,
blocks.translation: Purple with cold; whence o’er me comes a shudder,

blocks.source: e verrà sempre, de’ gelati guazzi.
blocks.translation: And evermore will come, at frozen ponds.

blocks.source: E mentre ch’andavamo inver’ lo mezzo
blocks.translation: And while we were advancing tow’rds the middle,

blocks.source: al quale ogne gravezza si rauna,
blocks.translation: Where everything of weight unites together,

blocks.source: e io tremava ne l’etterno rezzo;
blocks.translation: And I was shivering in the eternal shade,

blocks.source: se voler fu o destino o fortuna,
blocks.translation: Whether ’twere will, or destiny, or chance,

blocks.source: non so; ma, passeggiando tra le teste,
blocks.translation: I know not; but in walking ’mong the heads

blocks.source: forte percossi ’l piè nel viso ad una.
blocks.translation: I struck my foot hard in the face of one.

blocks.source: Piangendo mi sgridò: «Perché mi peste?
blocks.translation: Weeping he growled: “Why dost thou trample me?

blocks.source: se tu non vieni a crescer la vendetta
blocks.translation: Unless thou comest to increase the vengeance

blocks.source: di Montaperti, perché mi moleste?».
blocks.translation: of Montaperti, why dost thou molest me?”

blocks.source: E io: «Maestro mio, or qui m’aspetta,
blocks.translation: And I: “My Master, now wait here for me,

blocks.source: sì ch’io esca d’un dubbio per costui;
blocks.translation: That I through him may issue from a doubt;

blocks.source: poi mi farai, quantunque vorrai, fretta».
blocks.translation: Then thou mayst hurry me, as thou shalt wish.”

blocks.source: Lo duca stette, e io dissi a colui
blocks.translation: The Leader stopped; and to that one I said

blocks.source: che bestemmiava duramente ancora:
blocks.translation: Who was blaspheming vehemently still:

blocks.source: «Qual se’ tu che così rampogni altrui?».
blocks.translation: “Who art thou, that thus reprehendest others?”

blocks.source: «Or tu chi se’ che vai per l’Antenora,
blocks.translation: “Now who art thou, that goest through Antenora

blocks.source: percotendo», rispuose, «altrui le gote,
blocks.translation: Smiting,” replied he, “other people’s cheeks,

blocks.source: sì che, se fossi vivo, troppo fora?».
blocks.translation: So that, if thou wert living, ’twere too much?”

blocks.source: «Vivo son io, e caro esser ti puote»,
blocks.translation: “Living I am, and dear to thee it may be,”

blocks.source: fu mia risposta, «se dimandi fama,
blocks.translation: Was my response, “if thou demandest fame,

blocks.source: ch’io metta il nome tuo tra l’altre note».
blocks.translation: That ’mid the other notes thy name I place.”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Del contrario ho io brama.
blocks.translation: And he to me: “For the reverse I long;

blocks.source: Lèvati quinci e non mi dar più lagna,
blocks.translation: Take thyself hence, and give me no more trouble;

blocks.source: ché mal sai lusingar per questa lama!».
blocks.translation: For ill thou knowest to flatter in this hollow.”

blocks.source: Allor lo presi per la cuticagna
blocks.translation: Then by the scalp behind I seized upon him,

blocks.source: e dissi: «El converrà che tu ti nomi,
blocks.translation: And said: “It must needs be thou name thyself,

blocks.source: o che capel qui sù non ti rimagna».
blocks.translation: Or not a hair remain upon thee here.”

blocks.source: Ond’ elli a me: «Perché tu mi dischiomi,
blocks.translation: Whence he to me: “Though thou strip off my hair,

blocks.source: né ti dirò ch’io sia, né mosterrolti,
blocks.translation: I will not tell thee who I am, nor show thee,

blocks.source: se mille fiate in sul capo mi tomi».
blocks.translation: If on my head a thousand times thou fall.”

blocks.source: Io avea già i capelli in mano avvolti,
blocks.translation: I had his hair in hand already twisted,

blocks.source: e tratti glien’ avea più d’una ciocca,
blocks.translation: And more than one shock of it had pulled out,

blocks.source: latrando lui con li occhi in giù raccolti,
blocks.translation: He barking, with his eyes held firmly down,

blocks.source: quando un altro gridò: «Che hai tu, Bocca?
blocks.translation: When cried another: “What doth ail thee, Bocca?

blocks.source: non ti basta sonar con le mascelle,
blocks.translation: Is’t not enough to clatter with thy jaws,

blocks.source: se tu non latri? qual diavol ti tocca?».
blocks.translation: But thou must bark? what devil touches thee?”

blocks.source: «Omai», diss’ io, «non vo’ che più favelle,
blocks.translation: “Now,” said I, “I care not to have thee speak,

blocks.source: malvagio traditor; ch’a la tua onta
blocks.translation: Accursed traitor; for unto thy shame

blocks.source: io porterò di te vere novelle».
blocks.translation: I will report of thee veracious news.”

blocks.source: «Va via», rispuose, «e ciò che tu vuoi conta;
blocks.translation: “Begone,” replied he, “and tell what thou wilt,

blocks.source: ma non tacer, se tu di qua entro eschi,
blocks.translation: But be not silent, if thou issue hence,

blocks.source: di quel ch’ebbe or così la lingua pronta.
blocks.translation: Of him who had just now his tongue so prompt;

blocks.source: El piange qui l’argento de’ Franceschi:
blocks.translation: He weepeth here the silver of the French;

blocks.source: “Io vidi”, potrai dir, “quel da Duera
blocks.translation: ‘I saw,’ thus canst thou phrase it, ‘him of Duera

blocks.source: là dove i peccatori stanno freschi”.
blocks.translation: There where the sinners stand out in the cold.’

blocks.source: Se fossi domandato “Altri chi v’era?”,
blocks.translation: If thou shouldst questioned be who else was there,

blocks.source: tu hai dallato quel di Beccheria
blocks.translation: Thou hast beside thee him of Beccaria,

blocks.source: di cui segò Fiorenza la gorgiera.
blocks.translation: Of whom the gorget Florence slit asunder;

blocks.source: Gianni de’ Soldanier credo che sia
blocks.translation: Gianni del Soldanier, I think, may be

blocks.source: più là con Ganellone e Tebaldello,
blocks.translation: Yonder with Ganellon, and Tebaldello

blocks.source: ch’aprì Faenza quando si dormia».
blocks.translation: Who oped Faenza when the people slept.”

blocks.source: Noi eravam partiti già da ello,
blocks.translation: Already we had gone away from him,

blocks.source: ch’io vidi due ghiacciati in una buca,
blocks.translation: When I beheld two frozen in one hole,

blocks.source: sì che l’un capo a l’altro era cappello;
blocks.translation: So that one head a hood was to the other;

blocks.source: e come ’l pan per fame si manduca,
blocks.translation: And even as bread through hunger is devoured,

blocks.source: così ’l sovran li denti a l’altro pose
blocks.translation: The uppermost on the other set his teeth,

blocks.source: là ’ve ’l cervel s’aggiugne con la nuca:
blocks.translation: There where the brain is to the nape united.

blocks.source: non altrimenti Tidëo si rose
blocks.translation: Not in another fashion Tydeus gnawed

blocks.source: le tempie a Menalippo per disdegno,
blocks.translation: The temples of Menalippus in disdain,

blocks.source: che quei faceva il teschio e l’altre cose.
blocks.translation: Than that one did the skull and the other things.

blocks.source: «O tu che mostri per sì bestial segno
blocks.translation: “O thou, who showest by such bestial sign

blocks.source: odio sovra colui che tu ti mangi,
blocks.translation: Thy hatred against him whom thou art eating,

blocks.source: dimmi ’l perché», diss’ io, «per tal convegno,
blocks.translation: Tell me the wherefore,” said I, “with this compact,

blocks.source: che se tu a ragion di lui ti piangi,
blocks.translation: That if thou rightfully of him complain,

blocks.source: sappiendo chi voi siete e la sua pecca,
blocks.translation: In knowing who ye are, and his transgression,

blocks.source: nel mondo suso ancora io te ne cangi,
blocks.translation: I in the world above repay thee for it,

blocks.source: se quella con ch’io parlo non si secca».
blocks.translation: If that wherewith I speak be not dried up.”
